items.name: NVIDIA Campus
items.description: Folded triangular roofs and glass walls inspired by NVIDIA’s Santa Clara campus.

items.name: Painted Ladies
items.description: Three colourful San Francisco Victorian houses, with ornate gables, bay windows and front steps.

items.name: Pebble Beach
items.description: Pebble Beach’s seventh hole: a small coastal green above granite rocks and Pacific surf.

items.name: Granite Dome
items.description: Yosemite’s Half Dome, with a sheer granite face, rounded shoulder and dark valley pines.

items.name: Black Friday
items.description: A black shopping bag with a bold red discount tag for the big shopping day.

items.name: Cyber Monday
items.description: An online-shopping cart on a laptop, paired with a bright discount tag.

items.name: Palace of Fine Arts
items.description: San Francisco’s terracotta rotunda, classical columns and curved colonnades.

items.name: Coastal Cypress
items.description: A windswept Monterey cypress rooted in coastal granite above a curl of Pacific surf.

items.name: Salesforce Tower
items.description: San Francisco’s tapered glass tower, with curved sides and its rounded louvered crown.

items.name: Cupertino Loop
items.description: A miniature inspired by Apple’s original Infinite Loop campus, with separate buildings around a courtyard.

items.name: Diwali Diyas
items.description: Two lit terracotta diyas, warm gold flames and marigolds for the festival of lights.

items.name: Halloween Lantern
items.description: A glowing carved pumpkin with a crooked purple witch hat and a friendly grin.

items.name: MIDI Keyboard
items.description: A compact music controller with piano keys, lit performance pads and rotary knobs.

items.name: Analog Synth
items.description: An analog keyboard with walnut end cheeks, silver knobs and colourful patch cables.

items.name: Grand Piano
items.description: A polished black grand piano, open lid, golden strings and brass pedals.

items.name: Electric Guitar
items.description: A cherry-red six-string electric guitar with an ivory pickguard and chrome hardware.

items.name: Acoustic Guitar
items.description: A warm spruce and walnut acoustic guitar, with six strings and a round sound hole.

items.name: Ukulele
items.description: A little four-string koa ukulele, with a short neck and rich natural wood grain.

items.name: Concert Flute
items.description: A silver concert flute with raised round keys and delicate mechanical detail.

items.name: Saxophone
items.description: A golden-brass saxophone with curved neck, pearl keys and a wide flared bell.

items.name: Violin
items.description: An amber wooden violin with four strings, carved scroll and a slender bow.

items.name: Drum Kit
items.description: A midnight-blue drum kit with white drumheads, chrome stands and golden cymbals.

items.name: Bass Guitar
items.description: A midnight-blue four-string bass with a long maple neck and chrome bridge.

items.name: DJ Controller
items.description: A two-deck DJ console with jog wheels, mixer faders and colourful performance pads.
